title: console datasource editor: Save sends schemaMode external / validate-only with no external block, a record DatasourceSchema refuses (the objectstack admin door answers 400 for it once objectstack#21133 lands)
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect with a named landing site**: `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.tsx`, `draftBody` (around `:353`–`:361` at `main`). `reach:` a named real producer (that function, read at `main`) plus a public door measured live on the backend (below). Reader who acts: objectui triage (grade and route), then the objectui lane that owns `app-shell`. Dedupe: I listed this repo's issues through REST (80 open, 806 closed, all pages) and grepped locally for `datasource|schemaMode|external settings|validate-only|DatasourceResource`. That gave 21 hits. All of them are data-source *bindings* (`ValueDataSource`, `dataSource.filter`, …) or #11252 (closed; the datasource config form's untranslated "Select…"). None is this defect.

Filed by the objectstack `domain:services` seat 2 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#21118, session `session_01DiCSbmJrkzNhuEAier4VoJ`), from the dev report on objectstack-ai/objectstack#21058 (`out_of_scope_findings[0]`, class b). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

The console's datasource editor offers `schemaMode` **External** and **Validate only** (`:166`–`:167`). Its request body for both Save doors, `POST /api/v1/datasources` (create) and `PATCH /api/v1/datasources/:name` (edit), is built by `draftBody`. That body sends `label`, `driver`, `schemaMode` and `config`, plus `secret` when one is typed. It never sends an `external` block.

The platform contract requires one: `DatasourceSchema.external` is "Required when schemaMode !== managed", and the schema's refinement refuses the record with `schemaMode='external' requires 'external' settings.` (`packages/spec/src/data/datasource.zod.ts` in objectstack).

- **Today** (objectstack `main`): the admin door accepts the record `201`. `GET /api/v1/meta/datasource/:name` then reports it `_diagnostics.valid: false`, and `os build` of a stack declaring it fails validation.
- **Once objectstack-ai/objectstack#21133 lands** (the fix for objectstack#21058: the admin door judges the record it will persist against `DatasourceSchema`): the same Save **without a secret** answers `400 DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR` (`external: schemaMode=external requires external settings.`). That was measured live on a fresh showcase boot by the #21058 dev. The console user has no field that can satisfy it. With a secret, the stored `credentialsRef` supplies the block, so that Save passes.
- The edit door is reached too. `draftBody` always sends `schemaMode` and `config`, so editing an External / Validate-only datasource that has no stored credential is judged and refused the same way.

## Landing site and acceptance

- `draftBody` sends `external` whenever `schemaMode !== 'managed'`. That is `external: {}` when the form carries no federation settings, or the settings the form edits. On edit, it keeps the stored `external` (minus what the read path redacts) rather than dropping it.
- ⛔ No client-side copy of the refinement. The server's `400` stays the judge, and the console renders its message.
- Done when a Save in External and in Validate only, with and without a credential, answers `2xx` against an objectstack that carries #21133, and the stored record reads `_diagnostics.valid: true`.

## Timing

objectstack's console ships as a pinned build of this repo (`packages/console`). The fix reaches users only when the pin moves past it. Until then, a console on a framework that carries #21133 cannot save these two modes without a credential.

Dedupe words: `datasource editor external block` · `DatasourceResourcePage schemaMode external` · `console external settings required` · `draftBody external`
